sample_unit: sequential clinical MRI scans in independent validation cohort

links.outcome: Segmentation agreement and TKV error on independent clinical validation cohort versus manual analysts
links.effect: Median DICE 0.96 for left and right kidneys, median TKV error -1.8%, despite the validation cohort being older and having a different sex ratio than the training cohort.
links.quote: The median DICE score on the clinical validation data set between the algorithm and human analysts was 0.96 for left and right kidneys with a median TKV error of -1.8%.

unlisted_practices: AI-assisted segmentation with manual correction of algorithm output to reduce analyst time (56 min manual vs 8.5 min correction per scan)

screen.reason: The study develops and implements an AI tool for clinical use to segment kidney volume in ADPKD, evaluating the workflow time and performance when clinicians manually correct the algorithm output compared to fully manual segmentation.

primary.practice: human-in-the-loop manual correction of automated segmentation
